blocks.text: Alcohols aur phenols hydroxy compounds hain: aise organic compounds jin mein kam az kam aik hydroxyl group (-OH) aliphatic ya aryl (aromatic ring) carbon se jura ho, baaltarteeb. Yeh wasee taur par milte aur bohat kaam aate hain. Ethanol, jise ethyl alcohol ya grain alcohol bhi kehte hain, taqreeban har koi janta hai, aur alcohols eendhan ke taur par use ho sakte hain; ganne jaise paudon se bana ethanol biofuel ke taur par use hota hai.

Louis Pasteur ke kaam se bacteria ka wujood saamne aane ke baad 1867 mein surgeons ne operation ke auzaar aur zakhm phenol ke mehlool se saaf karna shuru kiye. Phenol ke taqatwar jaraseem kush asar ki wajah se mareez ke operation ke baad bachne ka imkan bohat barh gaya. Lekin phenol sehatmand tissue ko bhi jala deta hai, is liye is kaam ke liye bohat sakht tha, aur baad mein narm mutabadil dhoonde gaye. Phenol ab bhi kuch disinfectants, jaise sabun aur aspatal ke disinfectant maaye, ka juzw hai.

blocks.prompt: Alcohol aur phenol mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Alcohol mein -OH group aliphatic (ring ke baghair, sp3) carbon par hota hai; phenol mein yeh seedha aromatic ring ke carbon se jura hota hai.

items: Hydroxy compounds: aliphatic carbon par -OH (alcohols) ya aromatic ring par (phenols).
Ethanol eendhan aur biofuel; phenol ibtidai jaraseem kush.
